label: RESHAPE
recommendation: Keep the five blueprints as the product through GTC. Spend the two quarters on one counted test, and do not start dynamic-only stitching or the four-part platform unless that test passes.
conditions: All five blueprints still run at GTC, March 2027
By 1 Nov 2026, tag about 20 misses on one blueprint before any roadmap change
By 30 Nov 2026, count external teams that ran a blueprint on their GPUs in the prior 30 days
Stitching stays closed unless, by 31 Jan 2027, one outside team has run that blueprint twice and at least 50 of 100 misses are the fixed DAG
No four-part platform and no second vertical before that January result
next_steps: By 1 Nov 2026: tag about 20 misses on AV or defect
By 30 Nov 2026: count external blueprint runners; zero means one hand install and no new system
On 31 Jan 2027: apply the 50-of-100 gate; if it fails, ship the five fixed blueprints
cheapest_test: Tag about 20 misses on one blueprint this week and write whether anyone outside the team ran it.
kill_criteria: If the 31 Jan 2027 share is under 50 of 100, or no outside team has run the blueprint twice, ship the five fixed blueprints and do not start A or B.
